correctness.rationale: A perfect matching forces each selected part size to be at most half the total. Conversely, for 2q selected vertices with every part size at most q, ordering by part and pairing positions h and h+q gives a perfect matching; the condition also guarantees that at least two parts are represented, hence domination. Overload events for different parts are disjoint because two parts cannot each contribute q+1 vertices to a 2q-set, giving the coefficient formula. The support bound follows from the capacity sum. Independent brute-force checks on four small multipartite profiles matched the characterization.
